scope: All 4,464 current indexed PNG leaves are emitted into an isolated output tree. Supported retained aliases, rotations, raw-atlas component crops/isotropic scales, mask fills, and composites are hash-pinned and replayed. Catalog-only leaves are copied from the current index and exact-hash validated; they are not represented as regenerated from raw atlases. Each catalog-only reason and source-input availability is listed in catalog_only_outputs.
